# Microsoft Azure AI Foundry: Enterprise Autonomous Multi-Agent Swarm ### *Mission-Critical Supply Chain Orchestration for SAP S/4HANA & ServiceNow with Zero-Trust Governance* [![Azure AI Foundry](https://img.shields.io/badge/Azure%20AI%20Foundry-2026%20SDK-0078D4?logo=microsoftazure&logoColor=white)](https://azure.microsoft.com/) [![Azure Verified Modules](https://img.shields.io/badge/IaC-Azure%20Verified%20Modules%20(AVM)-blue?logo=azure)](./infra) [![Security: Zero Trust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Security-Zero%20Trust%20Passwordless-success)](./docs/security/threat-model.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](./LICENSE) > **Enterprise Workload:** Autonomous multi-agent coordination on **Azure AI Foundry (Agent Service)** bridging **SAP S/4HANA ERP**, **Azure AI Search**, and **ServiceNow ITSM** with a cryptographic **Two-Phase Commit Human Approval Gate**. --- ## 🏛️ System Architecture ```mermaid flowchart TD Sensor["🚨 Factory Line Shortage
(Part #GX-402: 0 Units)"] --> Orchestrator["🧠 Multi-Agent Orchestrator
(Azure AI Agent Service)"] subgraph Swarm ["The Autonomous AI Swarm"] Procurement["📦 1. Procurement Agent
(SAP OData Client)"] Contract["📄 2. Contract SLA Agent
(Azure AI Search)"] Compliance["⚖️ 3. Compliance Agent
(Two-Phase Commit Gate)"] end subgraph Systems ["Connected Enterprise Platforms"] SAP["🏢 SAP S/4HANA (ERP)"] Search[("🔍 Azure AI Search (2,000 MSAs)")] Teams["📱 Microsoft Teams (Adaptive Card)"] SNOW["🎫 ServiceNow (ITSM Change Request)"] end Orchestrator --> Procurement <--> SAP Orchestrator --> Contract <--> Search Orchestrator --> Compliance --> Teams Compliance -->|Upon Director Approval| SNOW ``` --- ## ⚡ Feature Matrix: Toy Tutorial vs. Enterprise Architecture | Capability | Naive Tutorial Approach | This Enterprise Architecture | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Authentication** | Hardcoded API keys in `.env` | **100% Passwordless (`DefaultAzureCredential` via Managed Identity)** | | **ERP Safety** | Direct unvalidated writes | **Two-Phase Commit (Draft PO staged until Teams signed approval)** | | **Contract Grounding** | Generic string stuffing | **Azure AI Search (Hybrid Vector + Semantic Ranker with exact citations)** | | **Audit Compliance** | Fragmented email threads | **Automated ServiceNow Change Request (`CHG0010294`) logging** | | **Deployment** | Manual console scripts | **Azure Verified Modules Bicep (`azd up`) + Dual-Engine Local Simulation** | --- ## 🚀 Quickstart (Run in 30 Seconds) ### Option 1: Zero-Cost Local Simulation (No Azure Account Required · $0.00) ```bash # 1. Clone repository git clone https://github.com/your-username/foundry-sap-servicenow-swarm.git cd foundry-sap-servicenow-swarm # 2. Install dependencies pip install -r requirements.txt # 3. Run interactive autonomous swarm demo python scripts/demo_run.py ``` ### Option 2: 1-Click Azure Cloud Deployment (Azure Developer CLI) ```bash azd auth login azd up ``` *(Provisions Resource Group, VNet, AI Foundry Hub, Projects, AI Search, and Managed Identities automatically)* --- ## 📂 Repository Structure ```text ├── .devcontainer/ # Instant VS Code / Codespaces dev environment ├── docs/ │ ├── adr/ # Architecture Decision Records (MADR 3.0 standard) │ │ └── 0001-two-phase-commit-erp.md │ ├── security/ # OWASP Top 10 for LLM Threat Matrix │ │ └── threat-model.md │ └── visualizer/ # Interactive p5.js animated flow visualizer ├── infra/ # Infrastructure-as-Code (AVM Bicep) │ └── main.bicep ├── src/ # Application & Agent Swarm Code │ ├── agents/ # Procurement, Contract SLA, and Compliance agents │ ├── tools/ # SAP OData, Contract Search, and ServiceNow tools │ ├── config.py # Pydantic Settings │ ├── foundry_client.py # Azure AI Foundry Client Adapter │ └── orchestrator.py # Multi-Agent Swarm Orchestrator ├── scripts/ # Interactive CLI demos and test runners │ ├── demo_run.py │ └── test_enterprise_tools.py ├── azure.yaml # Azure Developer CLI configuration ├── requirements.txt # Pinned dependencies └── README.md # Executive summary & architecture guide ``` --- ## 📄 Documentation & Standards * [Interactive p5.js Flow Visualizer](docs/visualizer/project1_flow_visualizer.html) * [ADR-0001: Two-Phase Commit Human Approval Gate](docs/adr/0001-two-phase-commit-erp.md) * [OWASP Top 10 for LLM Threat Model](docs/security/threat-model.md) * [Project Blueprint & Execution Ledger](01-enterprise-sap-servicenow-agent-swarm.md) --- ## 📜 License MIT License.
